# Discord
> Discord is a group chat platform for voice, video, and text conversations with friends, communities, and game players.

Discord combines real-time communication, community spaces, safety resources, developer tools, and support content for users, parents, creators, and advertisers.

## Core Platform
- [Discord Home](https://discord.com/): Main product homepage for group chat, voice, video, and community features.
- [Download Discord](https://discord.com/download): Download Discord apps for desktop, mobile, and other supported platforms.
- [Nitro](https://discord.com/nitro): Premium subscription features including perks, customization, and enhanced upload limits.
- [Servers](https://discord.com/servers): Discover public communities and server-based spaces on Discord.
- [Blog](https://discord.com/blog): Official announcements, product updates, community stories, and company news.
- [Careers](https://discord.com/careers): Company hiring page with open roles, culture, and team information.

## Support
- [Help Center](https://support.discord.com/hc): Official support portal for account, billing, safety, and product help articles.
- [Community Feedback](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/community/topics): User feedback forums for feature requests, ideas, and product discussions.
- [Submit a Request](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact support for account, billing, trust, and technical issues.
- [Status](https://discordstatus.com/): Service status page for incidents, outages, and platform component availability.

## Safety and Family Resources
- [Family Center](https://discord.com/safety-family-center): Central hub for family safety tools, supervision features, and guidance.
- [Parent Hub](https://discord.com/safety-parents): Resources and explainers for parents supporting teens on Discord.
- [Teen Charter](https://discord.com/safety-teen-charter): Guidance focused on teen safety, expectations, and healthy platform use.
- [Wellbeing Hub](https://discord.com/safety-wellbeing): Resources about digital wellbeing, healthy habits, and online experiences.
- [Safety Library](https://discord.com/safety-library): Collection of safety articles, explainers, and educational resources.
- [Safety News](https://discord.com/safety-news): Updates and announcements related to safety initiatives and programs.

## Privacy, Policy, and Transparency
- [Policy Hub](https://discord.com/safety-policies): Central access point for Discord policies, rules, and governance materials.
- [Privacy Hub](https://discord.com/safety-privacy): Privacy resources explaining data practices, controls, and user protections.
- [Transparency Hub](https://discord.com/safety-transparency): Information about enforcement, reporting, and transparency reporting efforts.
- [Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms): Legal terms governing use of Discord products and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://discord.com/privacy): Official privacy policy describing data collection, use, and rights.
- [Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines): Community rules and behavioral expectations for using Discord.
- [Safety Center](https://discord.com/safety): Overview of Discord’s safety approach, programs, and educational materials.

## Developers
- [Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers): Entry point for building apps, bots, and integrations on Discord.
- [Developer Documentation](https://discord.com/developers/docs): Technical docs for APIs, gateway events, OAuth2, and application features.
- [API Reference](https://discord.com/developers/docs/reference): Core API reference covering objects, endpoints, and platform conventions.
- [OAuth2 Documentation](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/oauth2): Authentication and authorization flows for Discord integrations.
- [Gateway Documentation](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/gateway): Real-time event gateway docs for bots and connected applications.
- [Interactions Documentation](https://discord.com/developers/docs/interactions/overview): Slash commands, components, and interaction-based application features.
- [Application Commands](https://discord.com/developers/docs/interactions/application-commands): Reference for slash commands, context menus, and command registration.
- [SDKs and Tools](https://discord.com/developers/docs/discord-social-sdk): Documentation for Discord social and game-related developer tooling.

## Advertising and Quests
- [Discord Quests](https://discord.com/ads/quests): Advertising product for rewarded campaigns and game discovery on Discord.
- [Success Stories](https://discord.com/ads/quests-success-stories): Case studies showing campaign outcomes from Discord Quests advertisers.
- [Quests FAQ](https://discord.com/ads/quests-faq): Frequently asked questions about Quests formats, setup, and campaign details.

## Community and Discovery
- [Explore Servers](https://discord.com/servers): Browse public servers and discover communities by interest.
- [Student Hubs](https://discord.com/student-hubs): School-based community spaces for verified students and campus groups.
- [Brand](https://discord.com/branding): Brand assets, logo usage guidance, and visual identity resources.
- [Merch Store](https://discordmerch.com/): Official Discord merchandise and branded products.

## Company and Legal
- [About](https://discord.com/company): Company overview, mission, and information about Discord as an organization.
- [Jobs](https://discord.com/careers): Open positions and recruiting information across Discord teams.
- [Press](https://discord.com/press): Press resources, announcements, and media information.
- [Partners](https://discord.com/partners): Information about Discord’s partner-related programs and community support.
- [Archive](https://discord.com/archive): Historical archive of terms, policies, and related legal documents.
